I think doxxers should be doxxed themselves...

Doxxing does far more harm to the doxxer then it does to the person doxed.

Now, you should never say something on the internet that you would not want to come back to haunt you. There is too much tracking software for you to believe that you are anonymous. So you should try to be a good citizen.

But, if someone is doxxed, and then something happens to the person who has been doxxed. then the doxxer can be prosecuted, even if it was unrelated. This is because of how the RICO laws are written. If the doxxing can be interpreted as a means to encourage harming this person, then the doxxer can be prosecuted. Its really up to the DA.

social media is new, and the laws have not really caught up to address it. But with the way they are interpreted, and current legal theory and precedence, doxxing someone is a really bad idea which may have legal repercussions.

But there are some really scary precedents opening up with jurisdiction thanks to the UCC and business disputes. the internet is not going to be the playground that it once was.
